description: Defines the USBDevice class and its Notification inner class, which implement plugin and USB device notification functionalities within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: USBDevice
classes.description: Represents a USB device plugin implementing IPlugin and JSONRPC interfaces, managing USB device notifications and lifecycle.

classes.name: Notification
classes.description: Inner class handling remote connection and USB device notifications, invoked on device plug-in/out events.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the given shell service.
